description: This file defines the SparkConnectGraphElementRegistry class, which manages registration of outputs, flows, and SQL elements in a Spark dataflow graph, including methods for registering outputs, flows, and SQL scripts, and converting source code locations to protobuf format.

classes.name: SparkConnectGraphElementRegistry
classes.description: A class that registers outputs and flows in a Spark Connect dataflow graph, handling different output types and flow registration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the registry with a SparkSession and dataflow graph ID, setting up internal client reference.

methods.name: register_output
methods.description: Registers an output (Table, MaterializedView, StreamingTable, TemporaryView, Sink) in the dataflow graph, constructing appropriate protobuf messages.

methods.name: register_flow
methods.description: Registers a flow in the dataflow graph, executing the flow function and converting the result into a protobuf relation.

methods.name: register_sql
methods.description: Registers an SQL script associated with a file path into the dataflow graph.
